newsitem.title: USA: Vinik group cuts Innovex stake to 6.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vinik group cuts Innovex stake to 6.5 pct.

text.p: A group led by former Magellan Fund manager Jeffrey Vinik said it reduced its stake in Innovex Inc to 6.5 percent, or 464,900 common shares.

In a filing Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold a net of 171,300 shares of Innovex between November 18 and December 2 at prices ranging from $38.965 to $40.8784 a share.

The group previously held an 8.9 percent stake, or 636,200 shares, in the Hopkins, Minn.,-based maker of precision electromagnetic products. Its stake is held for investment, according to a previous filing.
